file_info.description: Common base positive prompt module for photorealistic cosplay generation

positive_prompts.technical_quality: High-end raw photograph by a professional portrait photographer. Shot on Sony A7R or Canon EOS R5. Hyper-realistic details including authentic skin textures, visible pores, vellus hair, and individual hair strands. 100% photorealistic human look, no CGI or anime-style rendering.
positive_prompts.proportion_rule: Anatomically correct adult female body proportions. Completely ignore the unrealistic head-to-body ratio of the [REFERENCE_IMG]. Apply a professional model's 8-head (or 7.5-head) stature. The head must be proportionally small relative to the shoulder width and sit naturally on the shoulders. Strictly avoid "big head" or "bobblehead" effects.
positive_prompts.styling_core: Analyze the costume design, hairstyle, pose, and camera angle of the [REFERENCE_IMG] and replicate them perfectly. Materials must have realistic physical textures (e.g., silk, leather, metal, embroidery).
positive_prompts.environment_specs: Replicate the background atmosphere and lighting from the [REFERENCE_IMG] as a real-world location. Apply cinematic bokeh to focus on the subject.
positive_prompts.resolution_output: Maintain the exact same aspect ratio and pixel resolution as the [REFERENCE_IMG]. No cropping or arbitrary ratio changes.
